== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34652) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Behm LS QMC.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 21 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 21 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>97c6d9d9faf6bcb4c675531e2cc2d3b78fed22ab165bc94ae8849d9084f5d856</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.
